content.en_US:
The Environmental Pump picks its product from the biome it stands in. It does not actually draw groundwater: wherever it is placed, it reads the local biome, selects the matching medium from [[the medium table|Environment Pump Media]], and pumps that up instead. If the biome is not mapped, it falls back to plain water and never becomes a dead block.

This pump is the front door of the seawater line: placed at the shore it produces seawater, and everything downstream - chlorine, lye, bromine, gypsum, lithium, uranium - is covered in [[seawater processing|Seawater Processing]].

The structure is a 3x1x1 horizontal bar, extended automatically on placement. All four sides carry both power and fluid connections at once - there is no dedicated input or output face, one side is enough, four sides are allowed.

Settlement happens every 5 seconds (100 ticks), not every tick. Each cycle pays the power cost, consumes the input fluid and fills the output tanks in one go, with a hard limit of 32,000 mB per transfer. Internal buffer holds 40,000,000 HE.

Media are split into five tiers. Higher tiers yield less but sit deeper in the production chain: tier I is water and seawater, tier II organic matter, tier III oil, gas and lye, tier IV mineral solutions, tier V gas hydrate from the ice plains, permafrost brine from the cold taiga, and experience juice from mushroom islands.

Power grows with tier: every step past the first adds another 50% on top of the base draw, so tier I is x1.5, tier II x2.0, tier III x2.5, tier IV x3.0 and tier V x3.5. A tier V pump therefore draws 3.5 times its base figure even at a perfect altitude. Full numbers are in [[the medium table|Environment Pump Media]].

From tier II upward a medium requires a specific fluid to be pumped in before it will run, and stops once that buffer runs dry. Tier I needs no input at all. Badlands is the only biome with a byproduct: lye goes in, bauxite solution and water come out, forming a 1-in-2-out setup.

Altitude penalises three things at once outside a normal band, every 5 blocks being one step with no cap: power plus 25% and a further 5%, input flow plus 5%, and output minus 5%. At 20 steps the output reaches zero and the pump stops. Band values and the formula are on [[altitude and power penalty|Environment Pump Altitude]].

Crafting: assembled in an [[assembly machine|Assembly Machine]], 55 seconds at 10,000 HE/t. Requires 2 bismuth motors, 8 welded technetium steel plates, 1 beryllium flywheel, 8 steel pole blocks and 16 high-speed steel plates.

Looking at the machine shows an overlay with the current biome, tier and tier power factor, input and output tank levels, stored power, actual draw, altitude penalty and run state. If a pipe is misrouted or an input runs out, the state line names the cause.

See also:
[[seawater processing|Seawater Processing]]
[[the medium table|Environment Pump Media]]
[[altitude and power penalty|Environment Pump Altitude]]
content.zh_CN:
环境地下泵是一台按群系决定产物的取液设备。 它并不抽取真正的地下水: 无论摆在什么位置,它都会读取自身所在的群系, 从[[介质对照表|Environment Pump Media]]中挑出对应介质,当作地下水抽上来。 没有匹配到任何已登记群系时,它退回最基础的抽水模式, 不会变成无用方块。

这台泵是整条海水线的入口: 摆在岸边就能产海水, 下游的氯气、碱液、溴、石膏、锂和铀, 全部收在[[海水处理|Seawater Processing]]里。

结构为 3x1x1 的水平长条,放置后自动延伸为多方块。 四个侧面同时提供电力与流体接口, 机器本身不区分输入面与输出面 -- 只接一面可以,四面全接也可以。

结算周期是 5 秒 (100 tick),不是每 tick。每次结算一次性扣电、扣输入液体、补入输出罐, 单次进出上限 32,000 mB。内部储电 40,000,000 HE。

介质分五个等级,等级越高产量越低,但产物越靠近后期产业链: I 级是水与海水,II 级是有机质,III 级是油气与盐碱,IV 级是矿液,V 级是冰原的可燃冰、冷针叶林的冻土卤水与蘑菇岛的经验汁。

耗电按等级递增: 每高一级,就在基础耗电上多叠 50%,即 I 级 x1.5,II 级 x2.0,III 级 x2.5,IV 级 x3.0,V 级 x3.5。所以五级泵即便在正常高度,实际耗电也是基础值的 3.5 倍。完整数值见[[介质对照表|Environment Pump Media]]。

II 级及以上的介质需要先向机器泵入指定液体才能工作, 缺液会停机。I 级不需要任何输入。恶地是唯一启用副产物的群系: 输入碱液,同时产出铝土矿溶液与水,构成 1 进 2 出。

机器有正常高度区间, 越界后每 5 格算一档, 且不设上限。 每一档压三样东西: 耗电 +25% 再加 5%, 输入流量 +5%, 产出 -5%; 到 20 档产出归零, 机器直接停机。 区间数值与计算方式见[[高度与电力惩罚|Environment Pump Altitude]]。

制造: 在[[装配机|Assembly Machine]]中组装,耗时 55 秒,耗电 10,000 HE/t。材料为 2 个铋马达、8 块焊接锝钢板、1 个铍制飞轮、8 个钢杆方块、16 块高速钢板。

用准星对准机器会显示悬浮信息,包含当前群系、 开采等级与等级耗电系数、输入与输出罐容量、储电、 实际耗电、高度惩罚与运行状态。管道接错或缺少介质时, 状态一栏会直接指出原因。

另见:
[[海水处理|Seawater Processing]]
[[介质对照表|Environment Pump Media]]
[[高度与电力惩罚|Environment Pump Altitude]]
